# GrapheneOS public files used as test fixtures

All public, fetched over Tor on 2026-11-23 from `releases.grapheneos.org`.
No data from a phone.

- `bluejay-install-2026111800.zip.sig`: the signature of the Pixel 6a factory
  image 2026111800 (namespace `factory images`, `contact@grapheneos.org`).
- `bluejay-install-2026111800.zip.sha512`: SHA-512 of that zip
  (2,085,371,338 bytes, SHA-256
  `b40ac002f02aea550f1e8eda881eab4aff4dd6bbe387a917a506e376ac00eb82`), so the
  real signature can be checked without the 2 GB file.
- `bluejay-stable`: the stable channel file, `VERSION BUILD_TIME CODENAME CHANNEL`.
- `bluejay-stable-security-preview`: the security preview channel file, same
  format.
